hero.name: Ariana Peña
hero.tagline: I build web applications with Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. I turn what I learn into functional, secure products designed for real people.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Get to know me better
about.bio: I'm a self-taught developer from Peru. I build web products end to end and strengthen my foundations through algorithm practice. My most complete project, BiblioMatch, brings together secure authentication, roles, loan workflows, MongoDB, AI-assisted tools, and an interactive 3D library. I believe in learning by doing and documenting the process.

contact.description: Have an opportunity, an idea, or feedback on my work? Let's talk.
contact.name: Name
contact.availability: I'm currently open to junior opportunities, freelance projects, and collaborations where I can contribute, learn, and build useful software.
contact.github_note: For now, GitHub is my public contact channel. You can also review the code, activity, and real evolution of my projects there.
